value.name: Scrum value
value.about: Our player value: points added per 80 minutes above a replacement-level player in the same position, from a regression of the final margin on the process statistics.

rating.name: Our team rating
rating.about: Points better than an average test side on a neutral ground, with home advantage, travel and rest taken out.

val80: Our player value: points added to the final margin per 80 minutes above a replacement-level player in the same position group, from what each carry, break, tackle, turnover and penalty is worth (a model fitted on 2004-2018 tests), plus goal kicking above an average kicker.
tkpct: Tackle success: tackles made out of tackles attempted.
car: Carries (runs with the ball) per 80 minutes.
m: Metres gained with the ball in hand per 80 minutes.
pc: Penalties conceded per 80 minutes (fewer is better).
pts: Points scored per 80 minutes: tries, conversions, penalties and drop goals.
ta: Try assists (the last pass or kick before a try) per 80 minutes.
mpc: Metres per carry: how far a carry goes on average.
cb: Clean breaks (carries through the defensive line) per 80 minutes.
off: Offloads (passes out of a tackle) per 80 minutes.
mt: Missed tackles per 80 minutes (fewer is better).
toc: Turnovers conceded per 80 minutes (fewer is better).
kpct: Goal-kicking success: conversions and penalties kicked out of attempts.

pf: Points scored per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
tf: Tries scored per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
metres: Metres carried per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
gainline: Carries over the gain line (a share), opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
breaks: Clean breaks per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
beaten: Defenders beaten per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
offloads: Offloads per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
pa: Points conceded per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
ta: Tries conceded per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
tackle_pct: Tackle success (a share), opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
metres_a: Metres conceded per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
to_won: Turnovers won per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
scrum_pct: Scrums won (a share), opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
lineout_pct: Lineouts won (a share), opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
steals: Lineout steals per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
maul_m: Maul metres per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
pens: Penalties conceded per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
cards: Cards per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
to_conc: Turnovers conceded per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
kick_m: Kicking metres per test, opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
kick_pct: Goal-kicking success (a share), opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
terr: Territory (a share), opponent-adjusted over the last two years.
poss: Possession (a share), opponent-adjusted over the last two years.

view.why: Props and hookers: the tackle count and its success, carries and rucks; the set piece itself is a team stat.
Locks: the tackle and carry work (lineout wins are a team stat in our source).
Flankers and number 8s: tackles, carries and the metres after contact.
Scrum-halves and fly-halves: points (the goal kicker), passing, kicking and try assists.
Centres: metres, breaks and defenders beaten, then offloads and try assists.
Wings and full-backs: metres, breaks, tries and the kicking game.
